definitions.explanation: A distinct section or branch within an organization, field, or system of classification. Used for organizational units in companies and also for categories in competitions or awards.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}{部門|ぶもん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work in the sales department.

examples.japanese: {部門|ぶもん}{別|べつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンペティション→コンペティション：29647_konpetishon⟧{部門|ぶもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: That film was selected for the competition section of the international film festival.

notes:
{部門|ぶもん} is used for organizational divisions within companies and institutions, as well as for categories in competitions, awards, and classifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {営業|えいぎょう}{部門|ぶもん} (sales department)
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧{部門|ぶもん} (manufacturing division)
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧{部門|ぶもん} (research division)
- {部門|ぶもん}{別|べつ} (by department/category)
- {部門|ぶもん}{長|ちょう} (department head)

In awards contexts, {部門|ぶもん} corresponds to English "category" — for example, ⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧{部門|ぶもん} (Best Actress category). Distinct from ⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧ (section, post), which focuses more on the specific workplace assignment, and ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ (section, division), which is a more specific organizational unit within a larger department.
